info.title: IQAir AirVisual Universal API
info.description: Access IQAir AirVisual v2 air-quality and weather data, including supported countries, states, cities, city observations, nearest-city observations, station lookup, station observations, nearest-station observations, and global city ranking where available for the connected API plan.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name exactly as returned by the List Countries action.

schema.description: Country name exactly as returned by the List Countries action.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name exactly as returned by the List States action.

schema.description: State name exactly as returned by the List States action.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name exactly as returned by the List Cities action.

schema.description: City name exactly as returned by the List Cities action.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

city.description: City name for the requested air quality record.

country.description: Country name for the requested air quality record.

ws.description: Wind speed in meters per second.

location.description: Geospatial location payload for the city.

coordinates.description: Longitude and latitude coordinates in GeoJSON order.

state.description: State name for the requested air quality record.
